notes: Set of states; distinct from the truth set and a proof-equivalence class.
Typed source notation for worlds supporting the singleton formula; not cardinality.

Locally typed formula equivalence; not elementary equivalence of structures.

Doubled-vee composite reproduces the source connective without defining a shared style macro; support requires one whole-state disjunct.
Defined by negation and conjunction; always flat even when operands are questions.
Defined as inquisitive disjunction of phi and its negation; a polar question is formed from a statement.
World truth is singleton support; empty state supports every formula.
Replace each inquisitive disjunction by classical disjunction; preserves truth but may lose support information.

role: syntactic resolutions of a formula or premise set
notes: Each formula has finitely many nonempty classical resolutions; a set resolution selects one for each premise.

role: classical conjunction encoding a resolution-transfer function
notes: Conjoins alpha implies f(alpha) for every antecedent resolution.

role: canonical model on complete classical theories
notes: The empty intersection of worlds is all classical formulas.

notes: Empty conjunction is top; empty disjunction is bottom; Q may be empty.
Least positive bound on the size of substates needed to detect failure of support.

role: Dedekind antichain count for the subset lattice of an m-element set
notes: The InqB class count over \(n\) atoms is \(D(2^n)-1\); the empty antichain is excluded.
Primitives bottom/conjunction/implication/question mark; not the full doubled-vee language.
A state splits as a union of operand-supporting states; distinct from the P8 linear-logic tensor.
